name: Marianna Priscilla
original_name: マリアーナ・プリンシラ
source:
Likes: The sea, all kinds of beach and marine sports
Dislikes: Boredom

Class 3-A. An exchange student from Finland who is fluent at Japanese because she has studied it hard ever since she was little. A stubborn and popular girl who regards the protagonist as her little brother, and calls him "veli" ("brother" in Finnish).
